operations.name: Joe Vargo

expected.name: Joe Vargo
expected.description:
Joe Vargo was imprisoned at San Quentin State Prison during the era of California's criminal-syndicalism prosecutions, which sent more than a hundred IWW members and labor radicals to San Quentin and Folsom on one-to-fourteen-year terms. He appears on the International Labor Defense's rosters of American class-war prisoners in Labor Defender (1926-27); like most of the rank-and-file labor prisoners of the period, little else about his case entered the historical record.

Joseph Vargo, an IWW member from Sacramento, received a four-year prison sentence, which he served in San Quentin from April 1923 until his term expired.

operations.research_note: The Daily Worker March 2/3, 1926, page 4 birthday roster explicitly names Joe Vargo, San Quentin number 37762. Historical state-prison number, not a modern BOP register number. March 27 birthday has no birth year; no fabricated year added.

updates.sentence: Four-year sentence served at San Quentin beginning in April 1923; the individual release date is not established. The imposed term is not entered as an exact actual time-served total.

operations.research_note: Stephen M. Kohn, American Political Prisoners (1994), state criminal-syndicalism appendix, p. 168, identifies Joseph Vargo of Sacramento and explicitly dates San Quentin admission to April 1923. Day remains unknown; do not derive release by adding four years.

operations.name: James H. Manning

expected.name: James H. Manning
expected.description: James H. Manning was a laborer from Seattle, Washington. James H. Manning was convicted at the mass IWW trial in Chicago, sentenced to five years in prison and fined $30,000. He served in the Cook County Jail and Leavenworth Penitentiary.

operations.research_note: National Archives Leavenworth inmate-case index distinguishes James H. Manning, 13167, from James Manning, 3694. Full middle initial and prison match the Chicago IWW defendant. Historical register number, not a modern BOP number. No custody endpoints inferred from the index.
